info.name: EventHub-A2 — full API
info.description:
IFN636 Assessment 2, EventHub. Every backend endpoint, with the error cases alongside the successes.

Folders 4 and 5 are the Notifications and Audit Logging feature (FR-09, FR-10, NFR-04).

HOW TO RUN
1. Set baseUrl, either http://localhost:5001 or the deployed address.
2. Run the folders in order. The tests save the tokens and ids each later folder needs, so nothing has to be pasted by hand.
3. The three audit requests that expect 200 need an admin token. An admin cannot be registered through the API by design, so create the user directly in MongoDB with role 'admin', log in as them, and set adminToken.

Author: Nikhittha Mukkala

item.name: 5. Audit trail (FR-10, NFR-04, US-4.3)
item.description:
My feature. The Singleton AuditLogger's output, read back through the admin only endpoint.

The 200 requests need an admin account. There is no way to register one on purpose, so create it directly in MongoDB and put its token in the adminToken variable. The 401 and 403 requests run without it.
